gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Giraffe's stand-alone 1/4 in retractable pressure hose reel comes in two pressure ratings: 2,600 PSI with 65 ft of hose ($129.99 fixed, $149.99 detachable) and 4,000 PSI with 60 ft ($169.99 fixed, $179.99 detachable). Anyone building the separate-washer-plus-reel setup ChatGPT recommended has to match the reel's rating to the washer's maximum pressure.
standout_why: I checked Bob Vila's Grandfalls Pro review (cited), ProGarageGear (cited), CleanGearLab and our own current page. Bob Vila gives no fitting or accessory facts, only the 3,700 PSI rating, the 100 ft hose and stud/brick mounting. ProGarageGear pairs the Active 2.0 with a CoxReels or General Pump reel and covers the M22-14 mm vs 15 mm mismatch (it gives both sizes for the Active), the 20 A GFCI circuit and Giraffe's 'proprietary' fittings, but it says nothing about a reel's pressure rating or Giraffe's own reel variants. CleanGearLab only warns about M22-14/15 mismatches. Our page lists the Giraffe reel at $129.99 without saying that price is the 2,600 PSI / 65 ft version. The Giraffe blog page came back truncated (navigation only), so I could not compare against it.
decides: This confirms the picks rather than changing them. For a shopper who already owns a washer, or is building the modular setup ChatGPT favoured, the $129.99 Giraffe reel only fits washers rated at 2,600 PSI or less. Above that, the 4,000 PSI version at $169.99 is needed, which changes the cost of the build by $40 to $50. Our reel row should name the variant and its PSI ceiling. It does not change the all-in-one pick (Grandfalls Pro or Lite Pro), since those have their own reels.
